messages.ko: 웨이브!! 뮤직뱅크1위 축하해!!! 너무너무 고마워 사실 1위하자마자 든 생각은 트리플에스가 해냈다 라는 감정보다 웨이브가 해냈다!! 라는 감정이 더 든것같아 진짜 웨이브가 준 엄청 큰 선물같아 사실 아이돌꿈을 꾸면 제일 이뤄보고싶은건 공중파 음악방송 1위하고 축하받으면서 무대에 서있는 그런 꿈을 많이 꾸잖아 덕분에 이뤄서 너무 행복한 기억 남겼어 ㅎㅎ누군가를 응원한다는 건 생각보다 쉬운 일이 아니잖아 하루의 시간을 내서 무대를 봐주고 투표해주고 좋은 말을 남겨주고 내 일처럼 같이 기뻐하고 같이 속상해해 주는 거 정말 온마음을 다해 고마워 그리구 결과가 좋을 때만 함께하는 사이가 아니라 어떤 순간에도 서로를 믿어주고 응원하는 관계가 있다는 게 얼마나 소중한 일인지 알게 해줘서 너무 고마워 웨이브가 준 큰 선물 앞으로 계속 같이히면서 보답할게 트리플에스가!! 사랑해~~
messages.en: Wav!! Congratulations on getting Music Bank 1st place!!! Thank you so, so much. Honestly, the first thing I thought when we won wasn't 'tripleS did it'—it was more like 'Wav did it!!' It really felt like such a huge gift from Wav. When you dream of becoming an idol, one of the biggest dreams is standing on stage after getting 1st place on a public music show and receiving congratulations, right? Thanks to you, I got to experience that. It became such a happy memory for me. Supporting someone isn't actually an easy thing. Taking time out of your day to watch performances, vote, leave kind messages, celebrate like it's your own achievement, and feel sad together... I'm truly thankful with all my heart. And thank you for showing me how precious it is to have a relationship that isn't only there for good results, but one where we trust and support each other no matter what moment we're in. I'll keep repaying this huge gift Wav gave us by staying together moving forward. tripleS will!! I love you~~

messages.ko: 그리고 오늘 진짜 울뻔했는데 안구건조증때문에 안에서 나오진 않더라
messages.en: And today I almost cried for real, but because of my dry eyes, the tears stayed inside and didn't actually come out.
Seriously, thank you.
But okay, breaking the emotional moment for a second...
When I was monitoring...
the Sad Girl outfit...
I was like, 'Why is there a pig standing there?'
Even during the final ending, the unnies were standing in a straight line,
but somehow I looked like I was standing five steps ahead by myself because I looked huge.
Holding my stomach in was exhausting.

messages.ko: 아니 배나올까봐 밥도 중간 간식도 공차도 다 참은건데…
messages.en: I skipped meals, snacks, and even Gong Cha because I didn't want my stomach to show...
But honestly, today Wav looked prettier than me.
You stayed until the very end and kept cheering for us.
You're seriously so adorable I could die.
Because of you, these two weeks passed by in the blink of an eye.
I'm so sad it's already going by.
There are still 3 more days—let's do our best together!!
Wav is seriously cute and lovable.
Love you~

messages.ko: 무슨 소리야? 내일 6시에 베플 뮤비 나오잖아
messages.en: What are you talking about? The Best Friend MV comes out tomorrow at 6.
Huh?? Wait... was Music Bank 1st place a dream...?
What's Best Friend...? The teaser isn't even out yet.
WAIT!!!!!
Hold on.
That reply seriously feels like it came from the future.
That gave me chills.
Anyway, we enjoyed it well. Let's work hard for these next 3 days too!!!
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ

messages.ko: 나는 이제 숙소가서 씻고 좀 자디가
messages.en: Now I'm going back to the dorm, wash up, and get a little sleep.
Then I'll have to head back to the salon.
You worked hard today~
Haranghae 😍😍
This is first-week Music Bank Hayeon.
A gift~
Haranghae~
